description:
Enjoy self-grilling BBQ experience at Big Island Abalone property. You can enjoy locally grown foods such as locally grown beef, chicken and lots of seafood like not only Abalone, but also shrimps, oysters and lobsters. Try our house made seasoning and sauce as a extra flavor of ingredients.
We have all the foods, sauces, utensils and cookware, so you just bring yourself and enjoy self-grilling BBQ.
what_is_included:
* Self-grilling BBQ ingredients
* Seasonings and sauces
* All required BBQ equipment, cookware and utensils

what_is_included_items.value: All required BBQ equipment, cookware and utensils

what_is_not_included:
* Drinks (can buy at office/food truck)
* Transportation
* Tips to BBQ server
itinerary:
1. Be here 10 min before BBQ appointment time.
2. Get registration at the office.  Confirm or pay amount.
3. Move to BBQ site (or stop by the office to buy drinks before moving to BBQ site).
7. Call servers to bring BBQ food.
8. Server gives you cooking guideline.
9. Enjoy self-grilling BBQ!!!
10. Leave everything!  We take care of the rest.
highlights:
You can experience local premium food ingredients at reasonable price!  You are the captain of the ship, so you cook BBQ ingredients for your friends, family.

Easy set up and just bring your self!  You don't need to hustle cleaning after lunch.  We take care of the rest.
check_in_details:
Make sure waiver is signed in advance.  If you didn't electronically sign a waiver, you can sign on paper upon registration in the office.

Before moving to self-grilling BBQ site, stop by and buy drinks if you don't have your own drinks.
what_to_bring: You don't need any BBQ related items to bring.  We offer everything you need for self-grilling BBQ.
special_requirements: We are NOT a restaurant.  We are providing space, tools, foods but we are not cooking for you.  We provide you a cooking guideline so anyone can cook foods to enjoy BBQ!
faqs:
Q1: Can infants and toddlers participate?
A1: Yes they can.  But consider how much appetite they have and make an food order.

Q2: Is BBQ cooked by chef?
A2: No.  Our BBQ site isn't a restaurant.  So you cook yourself.  We serve cut foods and give you a guidance how to cook.

Q3: Is there any toilet?
A3: We have a regular toilet in the office and temporary toilets are available within the farm and BBQ site.

Q4: Can we bring own food for BBQ?
A4: No.  From safety stand point, we are not allowed to have customer brining their own BBQ food.

Q5: Are we able to bring BBQ back home?
A5: It depends.  You are not allowed to bring uncooked food ingredient with you.  However you can bring cooked food back home with your own risk.
